newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korean, Chinese ministers to meet on defector.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean, Chinese ministers to meet on defector.

text.p: South Korea said on Thursday its foreign minister Yoo Chong-ha would meet Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen in Singapore on Friday morning to discuss the issue of a top North Korean defector.

"It's one of the most important meetings between the two countries so far," Lee Kyu Hyung, Seoul's Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesman, told Reuters in Singapore. Top of the agenda would be the defection of Hwang Jang-yop, "the matter that concerns most of us at the moment," Lee said.
Hwang, a senior aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, walked into a South Korean embassy building in Beijing and asked for political asylum, South Korean officials said.
Pyongyang said Hwang had been kidnapped, a charge a spokesman for the South Korean embassy in Beijing denied, saying Hwang had arrived by taxi.
Yoo had originally abandoned plans to fly to Singapore for a meeting of European and Asian ministers on Saturday because of the crisis over Hwang, but decided to go ahead with the trip to meet Qian.
"Both parties have very great interest in what is going on in the northern (Korean) peninsula," spokesman Lee said.
